patch_description: Keep `import time` guaranteed at module level. Improve the search: (1) greedy construction as before, (2) local search alternating best-improvement insertion and adjacent/swap moves using a cached-cost delta evaluation where possible, (3) restarts from perturbed best with time budget check so all three workloads get their share of time. Key changes: fix the buggy insertion bookkeeping in the prior version (the best_j logic was broken), use both insertion and swap neighborhoods, and restart with double-bridge-style perturbation when stalled, always tracking global best. This yields lower makespans within the time budget.
